fact: Communications minister Amr Talaat said in June 2025 that the unified national property number will be required for any government service on a property, such as an electricity meter or building permit, and all government bodies will be bound to deal only through it.
title: وزير الاتصالات: مشروع الرقم العقاري القومي ينهي تكرار العناوين ويوحّد البيانات
